# Ice Motion Director

> Ice Motion Director is an open-source (Apache-2.0) set of agent skills that turns Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot and 40+ other coding agents into a motion design and video editing director. From one plain prompt, your footage or a reference, the agent researches the business, asks its open questions with four options each, then runs ten production stages (brief, concept, script, storyboard, look, animatic, build, sound, review, delivery) and renders a finished MP4 locally. Every frame is written as code (HTML, CSS, GSAP, HyperFrames, Remotion, Three.js, Lottie or FFmpeg), so renders are deterministic and text, numbers and logos are set exactly as approved. It needs no After Effects and no paid video model; AI image, video or voice generation is optional and only used when the user asks. Arabic and right-to-left are first class. Created by Omar-Tnzxo.

## Install

- Any agent: `npx skills add Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director` (add `-g --all` for every agent and every project without questions; needs Node 22.20 or newer)
- Claude Code plugin: `claude plugin marketplace add Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director`, then `claude plugin install ice-motion-director@ice-motion-director`
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director`, then `codex plugin add ice-motion-director@ice-motion-director`
- Cursor: `npx skills add Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director -a cursor`
- Gemini CLI: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director`
- GitHub Copilot: `copilot plugin marketplace add Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director`, then `copilot plugin install ice-motion-director@ice-motion-director`
- Prerequisites for rendering: Node.js, FFmpeg, Chrome or Chromium, Python 3

## Skills

- [ice-motion-director](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-motion-director): the router; reads the request and project state, picks the workflow and runs the ten-stage spine
- [ice-film](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-film): films from scratch in 12 film types (product launch, app ad, brand film, logo sting, kinetic type, data story, social short, hype promo, UI walkthrough, music video, art film, industry spot)
- [ice-explainer](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-explainer): narrated explainers where the voiceover leads, with word-timed captions
- [ice-remake](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-remake): a new film in the style of a reference video, site or image set, and portable style recipes
- [ice-edit](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-edit): editing real footage (long-form, podcast, talking-head ads, shorts and reels, B-roll overlays, showreels) with a word-level transcript
- [ice-lottie](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-lottie): Lottie JSON and UI motion (icons, loaders, micro-interactions, logo reveals) with a developer handoff
- [ice-ideas](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-ideas): concepts, hooks, scripts and storyboards without a render
- [ice-direction](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-direction): brief, questions, dated research, decisions log, color, type pairing and anti-sameness
- [ice-motion](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-motion): timing, easing, springs, cuts, camera and composition
- [ice-type](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-type): typography in motion, captions, readability and safe zones
- [ice-arabic](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-arabic): Arabic and right-to-left motion, bidi, numerals, captions and dialect
- [ice-audio](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-audio): music (licensed or generated by code), sound effects, voiceover, mixing and loudness
- [ice-styles](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-styles): 150+ film, art, drawing and motion styles
- [ice-style](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-style): the style library as presets to browse or start a film in one
- [ice-engines](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-engines): engine choice, determinism, render, export and platform specs
- [ice-assets](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-assets): truth sheet, licensed sourcing and real brand material
- [ice-qa](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice-qa): quality gates, independent critics, the cold-viewer clarity gate and the delivery report
- [ice, ice-status, ice-01-brief to ice-10-deliver](https://github.com/Omar-Tnzxo/ice-motion-director/tree/main/skills/ice): step mode commands that run, resume or check one stage at a time
